compiled_state.title: As a developer, all per-step validation commands run through wrappers that produce result artifacts
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend the wrapper pattern from Story 2 to every per-step validation command in COMMIT and REVIEW workflows: `test`, `format`, `lint`, classifier dispatch, reviewer-tier dispatch. Update the workflow docs to invoke wrappers; verifier reads from each command's artifact.

**Why**: Completes SC1's coverage so the verifier can read from artifacts (not stdout) for every validation command in scope. Without this, only the single step from Story 2 is verifier-protected.

**Scope**:
- IN: wrappers for `test`, `format`, `lint`, classifier-dispatch, and each reviewer-tier dispatch (light/standard/deep-arch + sonnet specialists); COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md and commit-workflow-validation.md updated to invoke `commit-step <name>` for each validation command; REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md updated to invoke wrappers for classifier and reviewer dispatches.
- OUT: overlay verification (Story 5); truncation immunity (Story 4); skip markers (Story 7); worktree handling (Story 6).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, every validation command in COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md, commit-workflow-validation.md, and REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md is invoked through `dso commit-step <name>`; the workflow docs are updated unambiguously (no command listed both wrapped and unwrapped).
  ← Satisfies: "SC1 — wrapper coverage"
- When this story is complete, each wrapper invocation produces a `<name>.result` artifact in the worktree's artifacts directory; verifier reads each artifact in turn.
  ← Satisfies: "SC1 — verifier reads from artifacts (not stdout) for each command"
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic.
  ← Satisfies: TDD Done-of-Done

## Considerations

- [Testing] Test-step wrapper writes its result artifact in addition to (not instead of) `record-test-status.sh --attest` output. Cross-worktree harvest (Story 6) relies on `--attest`; producing only the new wrapper artifact would orphan attestation. Wrapper must call `record-test-status.sh --attest` internally or write a parallel artifact recognized by the harvest path. Compose with the migration in `a524-fded` (background test primitive) so wrapper output capture works whether the test command runs synchronously or backgrounded.
- [Maintainability] Wrapper output capture for classifier and reviewer dispatch is provider-agnostic; the artifact contract (output format, exit code, finding-file presence) does not depend on a specific LLM provider (cross-epic with `f9f8-a15c-79e0-4dc3` Gemini provider abstraction).
- [Maintainability] Hook installation/registration via `reinstall-hooks.sh` must coordinate with `87e9-0bc8` polyglot test-gate so installation order is deterministic.
- [Performance] Each wrapper invocation must add <100ms overhead on top of the underlying command.
- [Maintainability] Wrapper artifacts include attribution metadata fields (skill name, agent ID, sub-agent context) for `e407-d35c` source attribution.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
